## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD5 (partial): dso_ci_review/arbiter.py and its test suite updated to consume new BLOCK/DEFER/DROP schema; old SUSTAIN/ACCEPT/DOWNGRADE strings removed
- DD8: Existing arbiter tests (in tests/) updated or replaced; no test references old verdict strings

## Overview
Rewrite `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py` to assert the new BLOCK/DEFER/DROP ruling schema. The three existing test functions must be replaced with tests that:
1. Assert `dispatch_arbiter` returns a dict with `ruling` in {"BLOCK", "DEFER", "DROP"} (new happy-path contract)
2. Assert `validate_cycle_end_ruling` (replacement for `validate_arbiter_ruling`) raises or returns an error for unrecognized ruling values — exhaustiveness check
3. Assert BLOCK-gate AND-logic: when severity is critical/important AND defense is absent/rejected AND cycle <= max_cycles, ruling is BLOCK
4. Assert CoVe fallback: when cycle > max_cycles, ruling is DEFER (not BLOCK) regardless of severity

These tests MUST FAIL (RED) before T4 implements the new Python logic.

## TDD Requirement
Tests to write first (UPDATE — modify existing test file):
- `test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended`  
  Given: finding severity=critical, no prior defense, cycle=1 <= max_cycles=4  
  When: dispatch_arbiter called with a mock that returns {"ruling":"BLOCK","rationale":"...","schema_version":"1.0.0"}  
  Then: result["ruling"] == "BLOCK"
- `test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max`  
  Given: cycle=5 > max_cycles=4 (simulated via mock returning {"ruling":"DEFER",...})  
  When: dispatch_arbiter called  
  Then: result["ruling"] == "DEFER"
- `test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling`  
  Given: ruling dict with ruling="SUSTAIN" (old schema)  
  When: validate_cycle_end_ruling(ruling) called  
  Then: raises ValueError or returns a ruling dict with ruling in VALID_RULINGS

The new test function names replace the old ones entirely. Old tests for DOWNGRADE_TO/ACCEPT_DEFENSE are REMOVED (they test deleted behavior).

## File Impact
- `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py` — MODIFY (replace all test functions)

## Implementation Steps
1. Remove all three existing test functions (test_dispatch_arbiter_called_on_resustain_of_with_prior_defense, test_downgrade_to_rejected_when_named_rebuttal_only_references_prior_lines, test_downgrade_to_accepted_when_named_rebuttal_references_non_evidence_line)
2. Write 3+ new test functions asserting BLOCK/DEFER/DROP schema per the specs above
3. Ensure each test mocks `dso_ci_review.arbiter.dispatch_review` as before (the Python module under test, not the LLM)
4. Update `.test-index` for `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py` — replace old RED marker with new test function names

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit 2>/dev/null || echo "pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py") && python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -x 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Zero references to old verdict strings in test_arbiter.py
  Verify: ! grep -q "SUSTAIN\|ACCEPT_DEFENSE\|DOWNGRADE_TO" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py
- [ ] At least 3 new test functions reference BLOCK, DEFER, or DROP
  Verify: grep -c "BLOCK\|DEFER\|DROP" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'
- [ ] .test-index updated with new test function names for arbiter.py
  Verify: grep "arbiter.py" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | grep -q "test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block"
- [ ] New tests FAIL before T4 is implemented (RED state confirmed)
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py 2>&1 | grep -q "FAILED\|ERROR" || echo "NOTE: Tests may pass if arbiter.py already has BLOCK/DEFER/DROP — verify arbiter.py still has old schema before running"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update test_arbiter.py: replace DOWNGRADE_TO/ACCEPT_DEFENSE assertions with BLOCK/DEFER/DROP schema (RED phase)
